character: feverish purple octopus, white towel round his head, red streaming eyes, loose tie, exactly eight arms, fills two thirds of frame
props: thermometer spat out at 0.3 and kept in one arm; eight loads, one per arm - coffee pot, drill, stamp, mop, phone, kettle, ledger, laptop; two clerks - their place is his arms until 6.75, never the floor; payslip, one coin
prop_continuity: towel stays on his head all ten seconds; thermometer stays in the same arm from 0.3; every load keeps moving
motion_rule: every window he covers ground down the aisle - charging the lens, wheeling or barging, never sitting; all eight arms work at once and each does its job WRONG; new shot size every window
environment: office aisle at the lens, desks both sides, bright midday sun; background under a third

audio.delivery: flat feverish male voice, blocked nose, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: ra-BO-ta-yu, VO-sem, RUK, zar-PLA-ty, rav-NO, khva-TA-yet, TOL-ko, DVE
audio.pacing: brisk, no drawling; nothing said after 6.75
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, mouth always clear and visible
audio.sfx: wet sniff, coffee splash, drill whine, stamp thud, load crashing, paper storm

timeline.a: bursts up the aisle and spits the thermometer into a free arm
charges at the lens, eight arms on eight jobs and every one done wrong, papers flying off the desks
fans all eight arms wide and pours the coffee pot over a seated clerk's head
drives the spinning drill through a clerk's monitor, sparks fanning at the lens
barges on up the aisle, shoulders down the clerk climbing his back
wheels a full turn on his whole body, all eight loads whipping out sideways
charges back the other way, the soaked clerk swinging off one arm
slams the rubber stamp on a clerk's forehead, leaving a mark reading БРАК in black capitals
rips the payslip off his chest and drives at the lens reading it
still striding, swings round holding up two arms with one coin, the other six let go and the load crashes
timeline.c: big low, two arms against the window

timeline.a: the mop arm swipes his own forehead, then wrings the mop out over the floor at the lens, drops huge and out of focus
the avalanche hits, both clerks dive in after the coin, the drill spins away
he strides over the wreckage with the coin, towel slipping over one eye
both clerks stampede after him through the paper storm, the stamped one huge at the lens

must_appear: towel and red eyes every window; coffee on a clerk's head at 1.2; drill through the monitor at 1.95; БРАК stamped on a forehead at 4.7; mop wrung out at the lens at 6.75
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, watermark, garbled or misspelled words, Latin letters on the stamp, thermometer in his mouth, mouth hidden while speaking, static camera, same shot size twice, he sits at a desk, he stands still while speaking, an arm doing its job correctly, an arm doing nothing before 6.75, a clerk on the floor before 6.75, him small in frame, the towel falling off, fewer than eight arms, English speech, any word after 6.75
